user.description:
The current user who sends the message
If empty, the message is from C3 Generative AI

status.description:
The status of the message
This should stay consistent with StudioGenAiChatStatus in StudioGenAiState.ts

thumbsUp.description: If user has given thumbs up for this message

thumbsDown.description: If user has given thumbs down for this message

feedbackId.description:
The database id of the feedback submitted for this message if any
If empty, no feedback has been submitted
If not empty, another feedback submitted for this message will update the existing feedback with the same id

loadingMessages.description: Loading messages, to be displayed while the message is in a pending state
